name: 3-course set menu (Half-Board / Full-Board / All-Inclusive)
rules: One starter or soup + one main + one dessert from the set-menu selection. Drinks included only in All-Inclusive.
choices: Starters: Garden Salad, Octopus Salad, Caprese, Caesar Salad, Lobster Bisque, Butternut Squash Soup | Mains: Wagyu Burger, Club Sandwich, Prawn Quesadillas, Vegetable Wrap, Chicken Wrap, any Pasta, Grilled Angus Medallion (beef jus & truffle, port wine or peppercorn sauce), Seared Tuna & Mango, Gambas al Ajillo, Sea Bass Mediterranean, Cajun Chicken | Desserts: Mango Sticky Rice, Fruit Platter, Ice Cream, Sorbet
